title: Demand Service Rate Programs: The Rate a Larger Prepaid Block Steps To
content:
Where the multiples sold stand at or above 2 and the owner holds an active preventive maintenance
agreement, the rate the block steps to is the tier's block hour rate at 0.94. Where the multiples sold
stand at or above 2 and the owner holds no active preventive maintenance agreement, the rate the block
steps to is the tier's block hour rate at 0.97. In any other case no step is taken off the rate the
block is sold at.

Whether an active preventive maintenance agreement stands on the account alongside the rate program is
read from the customer's Preventive Maintenance Agreements records.

The block hour rate each program publishes under the Demand Service Rate Programs:

| Program | Block hour rate (USD per hour) |
|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 0 |
| Priority Response Program | 0 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 132 |
| Emergency Response Program | 126 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 120 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 114 |

| The multiples sold | The owner's Preventive Maintenance Agreements standing | The rate the block steps to |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | an active agreement | the tier's block hour rate at 0.94 |
| 2 or more | no active agreement | the tier's block hour rate at 0.97 |
| fewer than 2 | either | no step is taken off the rate the block is sold at |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** On the Block Hour Service Program, whose block hour rate is 132 US
dollars an hour, 3 multiples sold to an owner holding an active preventive maintenance agreement step to
124.08 US dollars an hour; the same 3 multiples sold to an owner holding none step to 128.04 US dollars
an hour. A single multiple steps to neither figure.
